verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion is a fair question for an error-tracking SaaS, but the pack documents no retention settings and no deletion controls for errors or events. The only related item says Business and Enterprise accounts can replicate Insights data elsewhere to keep it longer than Honeybadger stores it. That implies a fixed vendor retention period, extended only by an export-style workaround, which is an adjacent feature rather than retention or deletion control.
